g.text: Separate reception and authentication clocks — k=5

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #465260

g.text: Delay percentiles condition on completed receptions/authentications; compare them with pending and lost fractions at right. Zero completions are not zero

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #465260

g.text: Across multiple seeds, plotted medians and p95 values are means of per-run percentiles, not pooled percentiles. Pending work is censored, not declared

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #465260

g.text: Source timestamps proxy observed emissions; onboard measurement age is unavailable. Authentication does not delay ordinary transmission.

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #465260

g.text: Follow-up after capture: 60 s; finite observation horizon, with no authentication-age expiry. One deterministic seed (1); no confidence intervals.

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #465260

g.text: Destructive overlap is an uncalibrated sensitivity model: one collision domain, all overlaps erased, no power/capture effects.
